ca_box_canyon_east.name: Box Canyon East
ca_box_canyon_east.note: Adventure Collective says cooler months/fall to early spring, no months named; MP season chart not readable.

co_goose_creek_molly_gulch_campground.name: Goose Creek/Molly Gulch Campground
co_goose_creek_molly_gulch_campground.note: No month-naming source found; south-facing slabs suggest cooler months but that is inference.

nc_dixon_school_boulders.name: Dixon School Boulders
nc_dixon_school_boulders.note: MP guidebook listing says Best Fall to Spring (words only); ClimbingAway says Jan-Sep (contradicts); CCC/KAYA charts empty.

wi_interstate_park.name: Interstate Park
wi_interstate_park.note: DNR page names no months; a generic state-park guide says May-Oct, not specific; another listing says all months.

bc_cougar_canyon.name: Cougar Canyon
bc_cougar_canyon.note: Only that it is an Okanagan crag with an early-spring visit; ClimbingAway lists all months; no month-naming source.

co_big_thompson_canyon.name: Big Thompson Canyon
co_big_thompson_canyon.note: Adventure Collective: spring through fall, holds icy/slick in cold months; no months named; MP chart unreadable.

nc_looking_glass_rock.name: Looking Glass Rock
nc_looking_glass_rock.note: Sources conflict: MP and SummitPost say fall and winter; advguides say fall and spring; mountain-forecast lists Mar-Jun, Sep-Nov (hiker data).

nh_russell_crags.name: Russell Crags
nh_russell_crags.note: No season found; forum says autumn most consistent for the region; The Nook is a winter/ice crag.

az_beardsley_bouldering.name: Beardsley Bouldering
az_beardsley_bouldering.note: No climbing source names months; Phoenix summer heat implies cool season but that is climate reasoning only.

wy_devils_tower.name: Devils Tower
wy_devils_tower.note: One guide: April through October prime, March earliest, November latest; NPS: busiest May-September. Voluntary climbing closure in June (cultural) and falcon route closures from early spring, so June is unclimbed by choice.

co_main_elk_creek.name: Main Elk Creek
co_main_elk_creek.note: Sendage says gaining popularity in winter due to southern exposure; Visit Glenwood says year-round; no months named.

nc_moore_s_wall_routes.name: Moore's Wall (Routes)
nc_moore_s_wall_routes.note: MP guide listing: Best Spring to Fall; Adventure Collective: spring and fall seasons; a climber blog names Sept start and Feb/Mar-May/June, summer heat/bugs. Window taken as shared spring + fall; winter workable only on south-facing Two Mile. Read from search snippets, not full pages.

sd_outlets.name: Outlets
sd_outlets.note: Custer climbing guide: any month possible, summer and fall most dependable (words only); no months.

mn_duluth_bouldering.name: Duluth Bouldering
mn_duluth_bouldering.note: No source on bouldering season found; travel sites favor Jun-Aug generally, not climbing-specific.

ny_s_books_tier.name: Books Tier
ny_s_books_tier.note: No seasonal guidance found; MP season widgets empty.

ny_h_southern_mountains.name: Southern Mountains
ny_h_southern_mountains.note: One guide: best April through mid-October; LOCALadk: Sept-Nov prime bouldering, summer humid; Poke-O guide: late spring to early fall. Sources speak for the Adirondacks as a whole, not only the southern crags; black flies May-June, peregrine closures in spring.

wa_tumwater_canyon.name: Tumwater Canyon
wa_tumwater_canyon.note: Outdoors NW: season about early March to early November; mojagear: mid-Sep to Oct prime; OpenBeta: best Mar/Apr and Oct/Nov; KAYA: spring and fall shoulder seasons. Summer hot, winter snowed in. Sources speak for Leavenworth/Tumwater generally; falcon closures on some walls to mid-July.

az_euro_dog_valley.name: Euro Dog Valley
az_euro_dog_valley.note: Queen Creek sources say fall through spring/winter and an MP forum poster says Oct/Nov, but no source names a full month window; not confirmed.

co_durango.name: Durango
co_durango.note: MP and Durango sources say spring and fall best, summer hot on sunny walls, winter cold (season words only; pages name no months).
